content: Isilaehi adi Bepaŋdi kotigoŋ yehitubu-lodaaŋ yanagitdok ninadigiŋ

O Isilaehi’walaŋ Kadoko, du talitimeŋ tinimiŋa dompa bopgeye ninigitaŋ, du kutikutinik nadinimbeŋ. Mapme kumopop foloŋ aŋelo heki yalakapmeeŋ looŋ itaŋ, du Ifeleim eŋ Benjamin tiŋa Manase mebop indi miŋgilaŋgoŋ mintanimiŋa saŋiniŋge tubumintaune kanim. Unduŋ tiŋa kotigoŋ nihitubu-lodaaŋ ninigilune memikniyedi mu nihitubu-kadakaneŋ.
Bepaŋ, kotigoŋ ninigilune du’walaŋkade unim. Tiyaugene kadakaneemneŋ doktiŋa siloŋ tobogoŋ tiŋa nihitubu-lodaweŋ.
Yahwe, Saŋiniŋ Molom, du maŋgande metamgeye nai kweheyeniŋ hinek kwihitanimiŋa yonadinik mu nadinimilaŋ?
Unduŋ tinimbune indi makunum gibitaŋ tiyam, kaŋ daunik meeniŋdi nanaŋe maliŋ toki tilak.
Du mebop noli magimagi itowiiŋ biyabulaŋ kaŋ buŋa nindihiŋa kwetnik nilombeiŋ. Tiŋa memikniyedi ninimpekit tiŋa niniŋgege tiiŋ.
Saŋiniŋ Molom, du kotigoŋ ninigilune du’walaŋkade unim. Tiyaugene kadakaneemneŋ doktiŋa siloŋ tobogoŋ tiŋa nihitubu-lodaweŋ.
Du koom Isip kwetneŋ wain youli kobuli niŋ dabugoŋ unduŋ ninigila buŋa metambop kwet iŋoŋ hatitaugiŋ hogohogok u yehikeleeŋ adi’walaŋ kwehikoŋ gineŋ indi ninigila wain wele unduŋ yetiguŋ.
Du kwet tutumbanimguŋ, kaŋ indi’walaŋ kokoinikdi kwet gineŋ fohinakaŋ kwetkwet udapmaguk.
Kaŋ taŋeniŋnikdi kweboboe yehikufuladapmaaŋ bem wapuhi sida u maaŋ yehikufulagiŋ.
Eŋ taŋeniŋnikdi kohoŋkohoŋ tiŋa tomboyoulune Meditelenien imeŋgwaŋ wapumneŋ eŋ Yufeletis imeneŋ uŋoŋ wooŋ hadapmaguk.
Iŋgoŋ du dediŋ doktiŋa gimbahaŋnik ubulaginekukuŋ? Da unduŋ tuguŋ doktiŋa nai indinde metamdi talipmeŋ yauŋila wain folooŋ kubo tiiŋ.
Eŋ makaye moiŋ maaniŋdi buŋa yehitilifagihiune maaŋ kwetfoloŋ ikiiŋ kaŋ kale moihi nolidi buŋa naiŋ.
Bepaŋ, Saŋiniŋ Molom, du kotigoŋ inditok nadinimbeŋ. Du kunum foloŋ haliŋa diweune foune nibilaŋ, indi adi waingeye dabugoŋ hakam. Unduŋ doktiŋa buŋa nihitubu-lodaweŋ.
Du da buŋa wain youli kobuli yetiguŋ lolak i tubulodaaŋ saŋiniŋ mimbeŋ.
Memikniyedi nihifidokooŋ kudup gineŋ nihikulahegiŋ. Unduŋ doktiŋa nadikwihitayemiŋa yehitubu-kadaka tibeŋ.
Iŋgoŋ indi adi datok yoŋa nibukahileguŋ, tiŋa undugoŋ nihitubu-ulihakaune bop wapum mintane saŋiniŋ nimguŋ. Wendoktiŋa nihitubu-lodaaŋ nibudokoweŋ.
Unduŋ tinimbune indi du kotigoŋ mu bigabuneem. Du nihitubu-lodaune hatiŋila yonadinik kamene du’walaŋkade uune wohoge ganintilooŋ hatiyaneem.
Yahwe, Saŋiniŋ Molom, du kotigoŋ ninigilune du’walaŋkade unim. Tiyaugene kadakaneemneŋ doktiŋa siloŋ tobogoŋ tiŋa nihitubu-lodaweŋ.
